name: neurovim-standalone
description: NeuroVim — a Vim-learning game. Monorepo: platform-neutral core + Obsidian/web adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build:plugin && npm run build:web
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:content && npm run desktop:dev --workspace @neurovim/adapter-web
scripts.build:dmg: npm run build:content && npm run desktop:build --workspace @neurovim/adapter-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @neurovim/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @neurovim/content && npm run typecheck --workspace @neurovim/adapter-obsidian && npm run typecheck --workspace @neurovim/adapter-web
